notes.content: Minimum grade of c- in major courses
Students must earn a minimum grade of C- in all courses taken to fulfill the major requirements; and must earn a minimum overall GPA of 2.0 in the major.

notes.content: All students in this major tailor their focus in the degree by choosing a suite of applied courses in one of the following five Emphasis Area options. The emphasis areas are designed to provide students with complementary skills in an applied field. Appropriate TechnologyCommunity Organizing - no lower division requirements to list below, see the catalog for detailsEcology & Conservation ScienceGeospatial AnalysisNote: students choosing this emphasis area should select GSP 101 & 101L from the Lower Division Core (instead of ESM 230). GSP 101 & 101L are prerequisites to other courses in this areaMedia ProductionImportant information for all emphasis areas: In the lower division core requirements, students choose between ESM 230-Environmental Methods or GSP 101 & 101L-Geospatial Concepts. Students choosing to take ESM 230 after transferring to Cal Poly Humboldt should be aware this course has a prerequisite of major course GEOG 106, as well as STAT 109 which is not required elsewhere in the major. See the Optional Prerequisite Courses section at the end of this agreement to view transferable courses which will meet this prerequisite.
